params.caption: 🕹️ Steam's review backlog delays another game's launch Post-apocalyptic railway game Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business missed its planned November 10 release because its launch build is still waiting on Steam's mandatory QA review. The studio says it has been waiting for weeks with no clear answer, adding to reports that Valve's approval queue keeps growing. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 20:09 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot ⏳ React if Valve needs to speed this up · 💬 Should devs plan around delays like this? #Steam #IndieGames #GamingNews
